comment: Cross-language golden cases for the stored roster.csv header rules. Both readers (Go: parseRosterLayout in cli/gh-teacher/internal/configrepo/students_csv.go; TS: parseRosterCsv in web/src/util/rosterCsv.ts) match columns by trimmed header NAME: at least one identity column (github_id, username, email) must be present, every other reserved column is optional, and any other column is preserved wherever it sits. Both must refuse the same malformed headers so neither tool writes a file the other rejects: no identity column, a duplicate name, and an extra name beginning with a spreadsheet formula trigger. `header` is the full header row; `accept` is whether a file with that header and one data row of matching width parses without a header problem. Update both readers in lockstep.

cases.why: a pre-role file: role is optional
teacher-added columns before and between ours
canonical columns in a different order
whitespace around a header name is trimmed
an empty header name is accepted
non-identity reserved columns are optional (no github_id)
a single identity column is enough
a renamed identity column is just another extra when another identity column remains
a duplicated extra column would clobber on read
an extra column reusing a canonical name
